The successful candidate will perform the full range of planning, coordinating and performing secure and nonsecure IT initiatives that support continuity of operations (COOP) and incident response (IR) facilities.

Work includes project management, process improvement, hands-on operational support, and contract oversight to ensure established cost, schedule, quality goals, and performance objectives are met; serving as an authoritative expert and consultant on IT business process improvements and information technologies, system implementation, and service delivery; and supporting the implementation and maintenance of IT service request processes that enable continuity and incident response programs.

Assignments involve the development and periodic review of IT and communications procedures and the resolution of related policy and technical issues relating to security requirements for the COOP program.

Additionally, the work involves regularly accessing and handling sensitive information, including Safeguards Information and classified/restricted data documents and/or materials.

Such duties include but are not limited to: The IT Project Manager (ITPM) oversees and maintains the agency's critical IT infrastructure, cloud environments, and software systems. This role troubleshoots complex technical issues, stays current on emerging technologies, and advises leadership on IT improvements and security needs.

The ITPM collaborates across the agency to apply consistent project management practices aligned with NRC's PMM. The role supports COOP and incident response operations, reviews agency policies for IT impact, and ensures reliable Digital Service Center (DSC) performance.

Key responsibilities include leading needs assessments, improving IT processes, coordinating efforts between Office of the Chief Information Officer and stakeholders, and conducting technical audits and feasibility studies.

The ITPM also develops business cases and cost estimates, ensures projects meet architectural and security standards, and supports key lifecycle activities such as Capital Planning and Investment Control (CPIC) and Office of Management and Budget (OMB) submissions, along with audits and risk assessments.

The role further contributes to strengthening business processes to enhance overall organizational efficiency. The ITPM represents the NRC in engagements with internal and external partners, sharing information on technologies, policies, and best practices.

They provide technical direction to contractors and oversee project scope, documentation, procurement materials, and project tracking.
Candidates may qualify for the 2210, Information Technology Management Series by meeting the Experience requirements specified in the Qualifications section of this announcement. Individuals must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below.

Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

In order to qualify for this position, you must have at least one year of specialized experience at the next lower grade level in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE is defined as: providing advanced IT project management and technical support for COOP and incident response operations, including maintaining secure and nonsecure infrastructure, resolving complex technical issues, and ensuring continuity readiness.

This experience includes leading IT projects using formal lifecycle methodologies; conducting analyses and developing business cases; applying cybersecurity, OPSEC, and regulatory requirements; properly handling sensitive, Safeguards, and classified information; coordinating with internal and external partners; and clearly communicating technical issues to senior leadership in support of mission-critical continuity and response programs.

The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate the following: 1. Demonstrated capability to plan, execute, control, and close medium- to large-scale IT projects using formal methodologies (e.g., PMM, CPIC), including scope, schedule, cost, project funding and budget activities, risk, reporting, and stakeholder engagement. 2.

Experience applying IT solutions to Continuity of Operations (COOP) and/or Incident Response (IR) programs, including facility support and alignment with security requirements; and coordination with agency and interagency stakeholders. 3.

Demonstrated ability to conduct audits, feasibility studies, tradeoffs, cost/benefit, and develop business cases; recommend IT solutions that enhance effectiveness, efficiency, and productivity. 4.

Experience evaluating knowledge and application of security requirements and controls, including the establishment and maintenance of IT systems which handle Safeguards Information and classified/restricted data in accordance with Federal and/or NRC policy. 5.

Demonstrated clarity, concision, and logic in oral and written communication; effectiveness in interagency coordination, preparation of technical documents, and stakeholder engagement (Interagency partners, HQ offices, OCIO, regions, contractors).

In accordance with Office of Personnel Management policy, federal employees are assumed to have gained experience by performing duties and responsibilities appropriate for their official series and grade level as described in their position description.

Experience that would not normally be part of the employee's position is creditable, however, when documented by satisfactory evidence, such as a signed memorandum from the employee's supervisor or an SF-50 or SF-52 documenting an official detail or other official assignment.

The documentation must indicate whether the duties were performed full time or, if part time, the "percentage of times" the other duties were performed. It is expected that this documentation is included in the employee's official personnel record.

In order to receive credit for experience in your resume that is not within the official series and grade level of your official position, you must provide a copy of the appropriate documentation of such experience as indicated above.

s.h: About the role and what you will be doing
s.t:
The Senior Project Manager provides senior-level expertise to plan, organise, control, and deliver large, complex infrastructure and data centre migration projects across Ensono's client portfolio.

Operating within the Global Project and Implementation (GPI) practice, this role manages multiple company-wide initiatives simultaneously — from scope definition and budget planning through to delivery and post-implementation review.

A key part of this position involves building and maintaining strong relationships with client sponsors and internal leaders, including regular on-site engagement at the client's London office.

The Senior Project Manager interfaces directly with client executive management to understand critical business priorities and ensures every project is completed within agreed scope, quality, time, and cost constraints.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure business requirements are clearly defined, understood, and documented

· Define project scope, risks, potential issues, and resource requirements at the outset of each engagement

· Ensure project benefits are realised while managing the impact of organisational change on the business and its clients

· Develop project phases and translate them into clear, measurable project plans

· Communicate internally and externally on delivery of work products, planning activities, and cross-organisational resource relationships

· Manage projects in full adherence to Ensono's project management methodology

· Manage project scope across mission, objectives, and requirements throughout the project lifecycle

· Manage project schedules, including key milestone dates and critical path tracking

· Lead the team in identifying project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; act as the primary escalation point and drive effective mitigation strategies to maintain project goals

· Provide leadership and strategic direction to the project team across all phases of delivery

· Oversee all project work streams, including timeline adherence, quality of deliverables, risk management, issue escalation, and stakeholder collaboration

· Work with all stakeholders to ensure governance frameworks and continuous improvement or transformation plans are established and maintained

· Establish deadlines, assign tasks, and monitor and summarise project progress for all relevant parties

· Develop business insights through analysis of results and communicate key findings to management to support data-driven decision-making

· Secure appropriate resources and personnel in collaboration with management to ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget

· Escalate barriers, risks, and issues that may impact timelines or deliverables in a timely and appropriate manner

· Manage the development of polished executive-level presentations and deliver findings to internal associates and external clients clearly and concisely

· Manage project status reporting in line with prescribed timelines for each engagement

· Develop measurement processes and methods to assess progress towards project goals and outcomes

· Manage project costs and budgets throughout the full delivery lifecycle

· Facilitate cross-training to support job rotation and minimise gaps in assignment coverage

· Provide coaching and constructive feedback to all project team members

· Mentor less experienced associates within the project management practice

· Interface with client executive management on-site at the client's London office to understand and address critical business issues and concerns

· Proficient in MS Office and MS Project

· Strong financial management skills, including experience with project budgeting and cost control

· Effective team management skills with the ability to lead matrixed, cross-functional teams

· Strong leadership and strategic direction capabilities

· IT outsourcing knowledge

· Strong infrastructure management experience

· ITIL and/or ITSM knowledge

· Ability to organise and define work in complex or ambiguous situations

· Ability to travel to the client's office in London as required

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or equivalent experience

· Minimum of 7 years of complex IT programme and project management experience

· Demonstrated experience managing large-scale infrastructure and data centre migration projects

· MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or Engineering preferred

· Project financial and revenue recognition experience preferred

**The Opportunity**
The Project Coordinator, Tech Ops supports our Integrated Project Teams (IPTs) and cross-IPT activities in the planning and execution of capital and operational projects.

As a central business operations partner, the role brings together financial and contracting management across the Tech Ops portfolio - covering purchasing and contracting execution, CapEx and OpEx planning, standardized reporting and the coordination of internal stakeholders and external partners.

In doing so, it ensures projects are delivered efficiently and transparently, in line with budget, forecast, and compliance requirements. You will not lead a single project, but enable many. The position reports to the Business Operations Lead in Tech Ops

· Manage the end-to-end processing of Professional Service and Consultant purchase orders and the related TechOps OpEx and CapEx contracting activities, ensuring timely creation and management of Purchase orders, accurate cost allocation across cost centers and projects, support invoice approvals, and adherence to established processes via the appropriate business service channels.
· Small Investment TechOps CapEx coordination: Support IPT leads and requesters in preparing and aligning CapEx requests, keep the Small Investment CapEx buckets in Clarity up to date. Ensuring capital TechOps projects are executed in line with overall project delivery & portfolio objectives.
· Partner with cost center managers and functional line management to support expense planning and ensuring alignment with budget and forecast cycles.
· Contribute to Tier Meetings by presenting updates on OpEx, CapEx, contracting topics, and provide guidance on new business operations initiatives.
· Act as a key interface for external partners and the Contracting, CDMO & CRO teams, supporting contract progression and the efficient sourcing and onboarding of resources for IPT teams, while ensuring compliance with legal and procurement standards and alignment on standardized forecasting approaches.

We are looking for a self-starter rather than a subject-matter specialist: someone who approaches people across the organization proactively, takes things into their own hands and is genuinely motivated by making processes better.

Degrees in Business Administration or Finance with relevant exposure are equally welcome.

Die Abteilung Planung & Ressourcen (P&R) des Generalsekretariats erbringt zentrale Dienstleistungen innerhalb der Direktion der Justiz und des Innern.

Diese umfassen unter anderem die Koordination bei Bau-, Unterhalts und Mietprojekten und die Unterstützung bei Logistik- und Infrastrukturanliegen für die rund 2'400 Mitarbeitenden an über 50 Standorten.
Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir zur Ergänzung unseres Teams Bau und Logistik eine:n Projektkoordinator:in (Pensum 80-100%, vorerst befristet auf 3 Jahre).
### Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich ###
* Als zentrale Ansprech- und Koordinationsstelle gegenüber der Direktion JI, der Baudirektion und weiteren Projektbeteiligten nimmst du die Bestellerrolle gemäss Mietermodell in verschiedensten Projekten wahr.
* Du berätst die Nutzerinnen und Nutzer bei der Formulierung ihrer Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass die Bestellungsgrundlagen einen klaren Projektrahmen vorgeben und die Bauvorhaben entsprechend der Bestellung umgesetzt werden.
* Du engagierst dich im Rahmen der Projektbegleitung und Projektkoordination für eine qualitativ hochwertige Projektabwicklung.
* Du analysierst, konkretisierst und dokumentierst Nutzeranforderungen, um die Erarbeitung von erforderlichen Planungs- und Entscheidungsgrundlagen sicherzustellen.
* Die Koordination und Weiterentwicklung der nutzerspezifischen Immobilienbedürfnisse sowie die Sicherstellung des Informationsflusses zwischen den relevanten Akteuren gehört ebenso zu deinen Aufgaben wie die Erarbeitung von Szenarien, Entscheidungsgrundlagen sowie Handlungsempfehlungen.
* Dazu kommen Aufgaben wie die Koordination der Bedürfniserhebungen und Bedarfsplanungen, die Mitwirkung bei der Bauinvestitionsplanung sowie die Prüfung der Flächenbelegung der Organisationseinheiten zuhanden des Immobilienamts und die Koordination der sicherheitsrelevanten Belange auf dem Stockwerk.
### Das bringst du mit ###
* Masterabschluss (Universität/ETH/FH/HF) im Bauwesen oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet sowie bereits Erfahrung in der Leitung von Hochbau- oder Infrastrukturprojekten, vorzugsweise im Verwaltungskontext
* Umfassende Erfahrung in der Abwicklung grosser und komplexer Bauvorhaben, ausgewiesene Kenntnisse in der Gebäude- und Sicherheitstechnik sowie Erfahrung in öffentlichen oder komplexen Organisationsstrukturen sind von Vorteil
* Erfahrung oder Interesse an Gefängnisbauten und Sicherheitsfragen
* Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, insbesondere im Qualitäts-, Kosten- und Termincontrolling
* Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Koordination, Analyse und Dokumentation sowie in der Erarbeitung und Implementierung von Vorgaben und Prozessen
* Du bist eine selbstorganisierte, verlässliche und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations- und Kooperationsfähigkeit mit Fokus auf die Anliegen der Nutzerinnen und Nutzer.
### Wir bieten ###
* Ein anspruchsvolles und spannendes Arbeitsgebiet
* Eine interdisziplinäre und bunte Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen
* Arbeitsbedingungen gemäss kantonalen Richtlinien
* Arbeitsort in unmittelbarer Nähe des Zürcher Hauptbahnhofes
### Interessiert? ###

Nous sommes un partenaire privilégié des moyennes et grandes entreprises, entrepreneurs et clients privés fortunés.

Nous proposons des solutions adaptées de financement, de placement et d-épargne à notre clientèle, en partenariat avec les services du groupe Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale, dans un esprit de soutien à l-économie suisse et ses acteurs. Notre établissement financier emploie plus de 480 collaboratrices et collaborateurs sur huit sites en Suisse.

Outre notre siège principal à Bâle, nous possédons des succursales à Fribourg, Genève, Lausanne, Lugano, Neuchâtel, Sion et Zurich.
Et si nous écrivions ensemble la prochaine étape de votre carrière ?
## **Votre Mission** ##
* Conseiller nos clients de manière globale et orientée vers leurs besoins, les aider à optimiser leur situation financière et leur recommander activement les produits et services bancaires correspondants.
* Solliciter et collaborer avec les services internes (juridique, fiscal, compliance, crédit, expert en investissement, etc.) et/ou externes en fonction des besoins du client afin de définir une stratégie de placement et d'offrir des solutions d-investissement, de financement et de structuration patrimoniale adaptées aux besoins du client et dans le respect de la politique commerciale de la Banque.
* Entretenir et assurer le suivi de la relation commerciale, à travers des contacts réguliers avec les clients (téléphone, visites, événements, etc.) afin de les tenir informés de l'évolution de leur patrimoine, de l'actualité financière et fiscale, de les fidéliser dans le but de les accompagner tout au long de leur vie et ainsi créer des opportunités de développement et de pérenniser la relation.
* Assurer la conformité et la documentation de la relation client (KYC, AML, MIFID, etc.), des transactions (KYT) en adéquation avec les procédures de la Banque afin de respecter la réglementation et de préserver la bonne réputation de la Banque.
* Développer le fonds de commerce existant, identifier les opportunités d'entrée en relation et de développement du fonds de commerce afin d'acquérir de nouveaux clients et prendre en charge les prospects qui se présentent à la Banque afin d-établir une relation commerciale
* Vous encouragez la collaboration au sein de la banque en développant et en transférant vos clients vers d'autres segments et en faisant appel à des spécialistes.
* Se tenir informé de l-actualité (économique, fiscale, etc.) et des réglementations afin de disposer des connaissances adéquates pour répondre aux besoins des clients et les conseiller de façon pertinente.
## **Votre Profil** ##
Au bénéfice d'une solide formation bancaire (université, école supérieure ou CFC) complété idéalement par une certification SAQ CWMA, vous justifiez d-une expérience confirmée dans la gestion de fortune et êtes à même d-identifier et prospecter de nouveaux clients par votre esprit entrepreneurial et votre connaissance du tissu socio-économique genevois.

Vous disposez d-une grande aisance relationnelle, de capacités de négociation, d-un bon esprit d-initiative et d-un sens des responsabilités développé. Vous êtes une personne positive et communicative qui accorde beaucoup d'importance au travail en équipe.

De langue maternelle française, vous disposez également de très bonnes connaissances d-anglais (B2).
## **Notre Offre** ##
Rejoindre CIC (Suisse), c-est évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et entrepreneurial où le développement des compétences est au cœur de nos valeurs. Grâce à une structure à taille humaine, nous cultivons proximité, réactivité et autonomie, avec des circuits de décision courts. Ici, chacun peut innover, oser et exprimer pleinement son potentiel.

Que vous soyez en début de carrière ou expert du secteur bancaire, vous évoluerez dans un cadre de travail attractif où le talent fait la différence et où de véritables opportunités de développement permettent de participer activement à la croissance de la banque.

You will own delivery for our software projects end to end: HubSpot CMS builds, custom development, system integrations, and AI agent engineering for enterprise B2B clients.

You sit inside the Engineering team, not next to it, which means you baseline the project, defend the estimate, run the delivery rhythm, and stay the single accountable person from kickoff to handover. If you are technical enough to argue with an engineer and commercial enough to negotiate scope with a client, this is that seat.

Own scope, budget, and timeline for a portfolio of software and agent engineering projects, from baseline to go-live.
Baseline every project properly: person-day estimates, milestones, dependencies, and a live risk log in Jira, Confluence, and Forecast.
Run one clear weekly delivery rhythm across the Engineering team: sprint reviews, risk reviews, change control, and a status pack clients actually read.
Protect the margin by catching scope drift early and turning it into signed Change Requests instead of unbilled work.
Challenge estimates. You will push back on both optimistic and padded numbers, and build an estimation model the team can reuse.
Lead distributed engineering squads across Böblingen and Lisbon without formal authority over them.
Automate your own reporting with AI tooling, so status packs take minutes rather than half a day.

Must-haves
5+ years running software delivery projects (web platforms, custom development, or integrations) in an agency, consultancy, or product organisation.
Demonstrable ownership of budget and scope, not just timeline coordination. You can talk through a project's numbers, not only its Gantt chart.
Enough technical depth to read an API contract, a data model, or a pull request and hold your own with senior engineers.
Experience negotiating scope changes with client stakeholders and converting them into commercial agreements.
German at business level (client steering committees run in German) plus fluent English (engineering work runs in English).
Comfort in a distributed setup with colleagues in two countries.
Nice-to-haves
Hands-on exposure to HubSpot CMS, HubSpot APIs, or a comparable platform ecosystem.
Experience with AI-assisted delivery work, agent workflows, or LLM tooling in a delivery context.
A background that started technical (development, QA, solution engineering) before moving into delivery management.
Your Team
You will report to the Practice Lead Development & Technology and join the Development Team inside Thorit's Development & Technology Practice, alongside software engineers, AI engineers, technical consultants, and UX designers across Böblingen and Lisbon.

The Team Lead Development seat is currently open, so you will work directly with the Practice Lead and have unusual room to shape how software delivery runs here. You will also work closely with the PMO Practice, which owns delivery method across the company.
Tech Stack
HubSpot (CMS, custom modules, APIs), Jira, Confluence, Forecast, Claude and Claude Code, GitHub and GitHub Actions, MCP-based agent tooling, Miro, Figma for design handover.

30 vacation days per year, plus Baden-Württemberg public holidays on top.
Hybrid working from our Böblingen HQ, in a team that is genuinely used to distributed collaboration.
Company pension plan with an employer contribution that grows with tenure, starting at 50 EUR per month.
Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service, and free brand choice.
Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month, usable in restaurants, supermarkets, and delivery apps.
Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility, and insurance, free to use.
E-scooters at the office for local trips during the working day.
Real AI exposure. You will not read about agentic delivery in a strategy deck, you will run the projects that build it and use AI tooling in your own daily work.
About Thorit
Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients across the DACH market, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Degree: architecture; or related field that included 60 semester hours of course work in architecture or related disciplines of which at least (1) 30 semester hours were in architectural design, and (2) 6 semester hours were in each of the following: structural technology, properties of materials and methods of construction, and environmental control systems.

The courses required for a degree in architecture generally place emphasis upon planning, esthetics, and materials and methods of construction, while the courses for an architectural engineering degree place equal or greater weight on the technical engineering aspects such as structural systems, mechanical systems, and the properties of materials.

Because of this difference in emphasis, persons with degrees in architecture may have a preference for work assignments that offer greater opportunities for them to express their artistic and creative abilities.

As a result, they may be more concerned with planning and design aspects of architecture, and persons with degrees in architectural engineering may be more engaged in aspects emphasizing technical engineering considerations.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower broadband NH-02, equivalent to the next to lower grade GS-11 or equivalent in the Federal Service.

Knowledge of drafting techniques and skills sufficient to convey design concepts and ideas and formulate working drawings.

Knowledge of standard contracting regulations, practices, and procedures; health, safety, and environmental requirements as outlined in applicable safety standards, regulations, and/or technical orders; program planning and budgeting cycles, financial control and budget systems, and management; environmental principles, practices, procedures, laws, regulations, and current legislative issues; and work classifications and regulatory and statutory restriction on the expenditures of appropriated and non-appropriated funds.

Knowledge of automated systems and programs such as Computer-Aided Design and Drafting, information management, project tracking, and other software programs. Ability to plan, conduct, and record site/facilities surveys and inspections.

Ability to research, analyze, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, and procedures in a variety of situations; recommend timely and economical solutions; plan and organize work; coordinate the work of other architects and engineering disciplines; communicate effectively, both orally and in writing; and maintain a good working relationship.

PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).
